001: Hey Lucas, did you sleep well in your new room?
Hey Camille, yeah, pretty well, even though the bed is a bit hard.
Really? You should ask the residence for a mattress topper.
That's a good idea, I'll go see the caretaker this afternoon.
Do you know if he's nice, the caretaker?
Yeah, he already helped me with the keys, he's very kind.
002: Hugo, did you manage to take your shower this morning?
No, there was no more hot water in the building.
That's annoying, does that happen often here?
It's the second time this week, unfortunately.
You should report it to the front desk.
Already done, they told me it would be fixed tomorrow.
003: Do you eat at the residence cafeteria often?
Yeah, at lunchtime, because it's quick and not too expensive.
And the food, is it decent?
It's okay, but it gets a bit repetitive after a while.
Do you never cook in the shared kitchen?
I do, on the weekends, but it's often really busy.
004: Manon, have you met your neighbors on your floor?
Yeah, I talked to a girl named Chloé.
She's really nice, she studies biology too.
Yeah, that's what we've planned to do next week.
005: Thomas, don't you think it's noisy here in the evening?
A bit, yeah, especially on Thursday nights.
It keeps me from concentrating on my homework.
You should invest in some earplugs, honestly.
I thought about it, but I'm afraid I won't hear my alarm.
Oh yeah, that's true, that is a problem.
006: Have you used the residence laundry room yet?
Yeah, yesterday for the first time, and it was pretty simple.
How many coins did you have to put in for one machine?
I put in three one-euro coins for the wash.
And the dryer, does it work well?
Yeah, but you have to book a time slot in advance.
007: Léa, are you having problems with your internet connection?
Yeah, it's been really slow for two days, it's a pain.
Did you call the university's IT department?
Not yet, I thought it would come back on its own.
No, you'd better call them quickly.
You're right, I'll do it in a bit.
008: Do you know if there's a study room in the residence?
Yeah, there's one on the ground floor, near the front desk.
What time is it open until in the evening?
It's open until ten o'clock, I think.
Perfect, I'll be able to go there after my dinner.
Careful, you have to book your spot on the website.
009: Antoine, did you sign the residence's house rules?
Yeah, I did it on the day I arrived.
Do you remember the quiet hours?
I think it's starting at ten o'clock.
Okay, I'll be careful not to make any noise.
Yeah, me too, to be respectful towards the others.
010: Do you have any plans for the weekend at the residence?
Yeah, there's a board game night organized on Saturday.
That's a good way to meet people.
Exactly, and I offered to make a cake.
A little, but I'm mostly going to buy drinks and chips.
